observed_gap.risk: Starting durable ownership would either replay stale intent or operate with ambiguous ownership.

preconditions: exact private allowlist equals the current stranded candidate set
task is queued and older than the frozen cutoff
runtime, queue, dispatch effect, outbox effect and extra audit history are absent
remediation_contract.transaction: All entity transitions and the PostgreSQL rollback collection update commit atomically.
remediation_contract.idempotency: A repeated apply bound to the same snapshot returns replayed without another mutation.
remediation_contract.rollback: Exact snapshot restoration is implemented and passed in an isolated real-PostgreSQL schema; live rollback was not needed or executed.
remediation_contract.file_mirror: The JSON rollback mirror preserves canonical PostgreSQL payloads without Pydantic default expansion.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The CLI treated the expected pre-apply cutover block as an error.
failed_attempts_and_rca.fix: Dry-run now records blocked_as_expected_before_apply without weakening the apply gate.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: Pydantic normalization added optional defaults to legacy file-mirror rows and changed the digest.
failed_attempts_and_rca.fix: Mirror synchronization now writes the canonical PostgreSQL payload directly; parity and stable restart passed.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The verifier assumed terminal-state keys although the bounded rollup API exposes history-class totals.
failed_attempts_and_rca.fix: Verification now combines the snapshot/apply hash chain with the bounded task-history total and current zero-stranded state.

claim_boundary: This proves controlled reconciliation of effect-free historical local task intent and stable worker recovery. It does not prove production queue migration, customer traffic, SLA, HA/DR or multi-node recovery.
